USAGE:
  sediment export sft [-h] --out OUT [--recipe {sft_curated,sft_verified}]
                      [--from FROM_BUNDLE]
                      [--profile {hf-trl-sft-v1,fireworks-sft-v1}]

  sft.jsonl — supervised training targets

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             output directory
  --recipe {sft_curated,sft_verified}
                        evidence recipe (default: sft_curated; sft_verified
                        requires opt-in)
  --from FROM_BUNDLE    validated derived bundle directory
  --profile {hf-trl-sft-v1,fireworks-sft-v1}
                        exact optional consumer compatibility profile
